title: Partner with Niko
hero.body: Instead of pasting a bot message into your partnership channel, share a single link. Discord turns it into a clean card — headline, gallery and working buttons — so your recommendation looks deliberate, and joining takes one tap.
hero.note: Members who open it land on this page and can add Niko straight to their own server.
card.aria: The partnership card Discord shows for this link
card.title: Partner with Niko
card.subtitle: A friendly bot for communities that care
card.lead: Niko keeps the busywork off your staff: AutoMod that explains itself, private tickets, leveling, music, games and a full economy — configured from a dashboard.
card.partners.listing: A permanent listing with your own description
card.partners.shoutout: A shout-out from the partnerships team
card.caption: Your link renders as this card
section.title: Tools your members will notice.
section.body: Niko is built to be configured once and then trusted: a dashboard for the staff team, and features members actually use.
benefits.calm.title: Moderation that stays calm
benefits.calm.body: Warnings, timeouts and AutoMod that explain what happened, so a rule break never turns into an argument.
benefits.stay.title: Reasons to stay
benefits.stay.body: Leveling, an economy, games, music and a weekly lottery give people a reason to come back tomorrow.
benefits.help.title: Help without a queue
benefits.help.body: Private tickets, a public help forum and an assistant that answers the small questions for you.
terms.get.title: Something worth sharing.
terms.benefits.1: A permanent listing in our partners channel, with the description you write
terms.benefits.2: A shout-out for your community from the partnerships team
terms.benefits.3: A direct line to us when something needs a human
terms.look.title: A community, not a link drop.
terms.expect.1: An active, well-moderated community with a clear purpose
terms.expect.2: Advertisements people opt into — no mass DMs, no invite bait
terms.expect.3: Nothing built around scams, hate, or NSFW content
cta.body: Partnerships are reviewed by the Niko team. Introduce your community in the support server and we will take it from there.
